appliesTo: future full-pool rescoring; does not alter committed v1.2 artifacts

networkingRelevance.passRule: Explicit supplied evidence must show that the company sells, distributes, specifies, buys, designs, installs, deploys, operates or maintains active networking hardware, or implements WLAN/LAN projects that directly require it.
activeEquipmentExamples: wireless AP, mesh or WLAN controller
network firewall, security gateway or network-management controller
acceptableEvidence: explicit WLAN/LAN design, specification, BOM, procurement, deployment or maintenance
insufficientAlone: structured cabling, fiber or low-voltage work
networkingRelevance.pureCablingBoundary: A pure cabling company may be a valid Installer but fails this Cudy relevance gate without active-equipment evidence.
networkingRelevance.unknownHandling: Missing public proof is not demonstrated, not confirmed factual irrelevance; not demonstrated fails the benchmark gate.
networkingRelevance.separateFitDimension: Passing the gate does not imply high Cudy product/use-case fit.

evidenceSources.claimLinking: Identity, market presence, networking relevance, channel role and cooperation path must each be linked to supporting URLs and excerpts.
evidenceSources.discoveryOnly: Search snippets, provider summaries and AI-generated summaries may discover a candidate but cannot independently prove a claim.
evidenceSources.identityRule: Company name, claimed official URL and evidence entity must refer to the same business; an unmatched or wrong official URL fails sufficient evidence until corrected.
evidenceSources.directOfficialRule: One concrete company-owned official page can satisfy the basic evidence floor.
evidenceSources.standardAlternative: Without direct official evidence, a standard candidate normally needs two non-duplicative public origins.
evidenceSources.longTailSmallCompanyException: A deterministically confirmed or probable small long-tail lead does not require multiple independent sources. One identity-clear official marketplace store, official company/profile/social page, Google Business-style page or other concrete auditable public source can satisfy the basic evidence floor.

longTailClassification.confirmed: Positive direct small-company evidence plus a long-tail public-information signal.
longTailClassification.probable: At least two different positive structural size signals plus a long-tail public-information signal; the signals may be present in one identity-clear source.
structuralSignals: official small storefront or marketplace profile
longTailSignals: official marketplace or platform business profile
longTailClassification.largeOverride: Explicit 250+ employees or a clearly large national branch/group footprint prevents the exception.
prohibitedInference: missing employees, revenue, warehouse or brand information
longTailClassification.fallback: Insufficient positive evidence remains unknown and uses the standard evidence profile.

evidenceSources.duplicateRule: Mirrors, repeated excerpts and pages from the same origin count once for corroboration.
evidenceSources.scoringBoundary: The derived long-tail profile changes eligibility only; it contributes zero fit, role, cooperation-path or evidence-reliability points.

cooperationPathCaps.tier1Evidence: brand onboarding/direct procurement/import plus repeatable downstream supply
cooperationPathCaps.b2bResaleEvidence: purchasing, live listing/ordering, quotation and recommendation control
cooperationPathCaps.projectServicesEvidence: design/specification/BOM, procurement/vendor selection and deployment responsibility
cooperationPathCaps.currentRelationshipRule: A live public Cudy listing can prove the path; a current-relationship label alone adds no points.
cooperationPathCaps.unknownRule: Undisclosed procurement or control remains unknown, not a factual negative, but cannot support a higher level.
cooperationPathCaps.scaleRule: Company size does not increase cooperation-path score.

multiRoleChannelMembership.noBusinessShareInference: Do not infer role proportions or a dominant role from public-page volume, search rank or model impression.
multiRoleChannelMembership.laneAdmission: Pass a submitted lane when evidence proves that the company genuinely conducts at least one role allowed in that lane, regardless of other roles or business proportions.
multiRoleChannelMembership.multiLaneRule: One company may qualify for several lanes when each business is supported by corresponding evidence; the long-tail single-source exception still applies.
multiRoleChannelMembership.distributionBoundary: Require downstream supply or explicit distributor/wholesaler identity; direct brand buying for final-customer service remains VAR/DVAR.
multiRoleChannelMembership.vadBoundary: VAD requires Distributor status plus substantive technical enablement.
multiRoleChannelMembership.varBoundary: VAR requires actual resale to final customers plus substantive technical value; project work without resale may be SI but not VAR.
multiRoleChannelMembership.serviceBoundary: SI requires solution/architecture/integration or project-outcome responsibility; installation execution alone supports Installer, not SI.
multiRoleChannelMembership.possibleRoleRule: An indicated but unproven role may be retained as possible/pending and does not pass its lane.
multiRoleChannelMembership.categoryMetric: Measure supported submitted-lane membership, not agreement on one forced primary role.
